items.title: Zcash is about to freeze $16 million in its oldest privacy pool
items.summary: About 12,200 ZEC remains in Sprout, the privacy pool Zcash launched in 2016. Roughly 10,000 coins have left over the past week, but only about 40 moved out Wednesday.

items.title: The pile of lawsuits against Kalshi just grew by one
items.summary: Arkansas has accused the prediction market of running illegal gambling, joining Utah and several other U.S. states that have filed criminal or civil charges.

items.title: XRP Ledger fixes a disclosed bug that could have led to the creation of new tokens
items.summary: The fix went live Wednesday after validator support reset the activation clock in October. XRP itself was unaffected.

items.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 as Zcash jumps 12% in post-election crypto rebound
items.summary: Ether rose 8% as falling oil prices and a weaker dollar helped markets recover, even as traders weighed a tougher path for U.S. crypto legislation.

items.title: Trump Media moves $342 million in bitcoin to Crypto.com, blockchain data show
items.summary: A wallet supposedly linked to Trump Media has made a large BTC transfer to Crypto.com, data tracked by Arkham show.

items.title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
items.summary: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight and questions over how long their rules will last, experts said.

items.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
items.summary: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

items.title: Crypto's powerhouse super PAC suffers costly setback as Democrats sweep Congress
items.summary: The industry's primary campaign arm had cultivated a reputation as an unstoppable force, but more than a third of its spending failed to hit the mark, especially in Ohio.

items.title: U.S. Democratic sweep could be the final nail in the ‘Clarity Act’s coffin’
items.summary: Industry experts warn the Clarity Act is likely dead in its current form as incoming Democratic majorities eye tighter scrutiny of crypto markets and tokenized stocks.

items.title: Wall Street rethinks AI data center boom as Texas election raises new risks
items.summary: Bitcoin miners pivoting to AI face new uncertainty over power access and construction permits, while companies with approved projects could benefit from tighter supply.

items.title: Bitcoin win rate vs. S&amp;P 500 recovers as post-midterm history favors stocks
items.summary: Bitcoin outperformed the S&amp;P 500 in half of the past 90 US trading sessions, while historical midterm data highlights gains for stocks.

items.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
items.summary: South Korea is seeking a fourth delay to its 22% crypto tax, months after reaffirming plans to begin taxing digital asset gains in January 2027.

items.title: France budget rejection sidelines stablecoin tax, wallet reporting
items.summary: Three adopted amendments, including stablecoin taxation and self-custody reporting, fall away but could be reintroduced in the Senate.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs draw $128M as crypto rebounds after midterms
items.summary: Fidelity led Bitcoin ETF inflows, while BlackRock’s IBIT shed another $201 million, extending its outflow streak to four trading sessions.

items.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack, assesses losses
items.summary: The bank said customer funds were unaffected after attackers accessed its systems through a service provider’s platform.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
items.summary: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

items.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
items.summary: Democrats wasted little time after their midterm victory, warning tech CEOs to prepare for subpoenas and signaling fresh investigations into Trump’s business dealings.

items.title: India warns AI-powered hackers targeting crypto exchanges at ‘machine speed’
items.summary: India’s cybersecurity agency says a threat actor is escalating an AI-assisted hacking campaign targeting crypto exchanges and other financial firms.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin says phased reopening to begin Monday, will cover losses
items.summary: Customers will initially be able to view their holdings, while withdrawals and trading remain suspended pending security checks.

items.title: Arkansas Sues Kalshi, Joining a Growing List of States Targeting Prediction Markets
items.summary: Attorney General Tim Griffin said betting on "whether the Razorbacks win or lose" is gambling, and wants restitution, penalties and taxes.

items.title: Why Bitcoin's Next Soft Fork Could Feel Like a Practice Run
items.summary: Matt Corallo explains why patching four legacy bugs is about rebuilding muscle memory, just as much as it’s about Bitcoin maintenance.

items.title: ChatGPT Is Getting a GIF Maker Powered by OpenAI's Unannounced Images 2.6 Model
items.summary: OpenAI is rolling out animated GIF creation in ChatGPT, with frame-by-frame editing and speed controls.

items.title: Google Tells Schools They Can Reject AI—But They'll Lose Search, Too
items.summary: Google is giving schools more control over Gemini, but districts that want Search without AI are out of luck, fueling accusations that the company is pressuring educators into adopting AI.

items.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
items.summary: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

items.title: US Bank Regulator Issues First AI Framework as Banks Battle Rogue Agents
items.summary: The OCC's first examiner guide weighs autonomy and financial harm, and directly addresses outside AI agents—the same risk that recently prompted major banks to restrict customer-account access.

items.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
items.summary: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.

items.title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up
items.summary: SEC staff said they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and won’t recommend enforcement over how it’s minted, a week after DTCC launched a tokenization service that runs partly on the Canton Network.

items.title: What Is x402? How AI Agents Pay With Crypto
items.summary: Coinbase's x402 protocol puts the web's long-unused 402 code to work so AI agents and apps can pay for APIs and data in stablecoins like USDC.

items.title: Tech, AI Stocks Split After Democratic Sweep: Microsoft Jumps, Tesla and Nvidia Tank
items.summary: Microsoft and Alphabet surged while Nvidia and Tesla fell, highlighting a divided market as investors reassess Washington's approach to AI and Big Tech.
